# Auxiliary Memory

> > Personal essays and reflections by James Wallace Harris, a retired programmer exploring aging, memory, science fiction, and the search for meaning in later life.

Harris writes introspective essays blending autobiography with cultural commentary, covering topics from his programming career to science fiction literature, recurring dreams, music discovery, and philosophical questions about identity and purpose in retirement. The site serves as a digital commonplace book—auxiliary memory—for preserving thoughts and experiences.

## Key Topics

- James Wallace Harris
- Retirement and aging
- Personal essays and reflection
- Science fiction literature
- Memory and cognition
- Existential questions
- Dream analysis
- Life purpose and identity
- Programming career
- Music discovery
- Reading autobiography
- Social isolation and loneliness
- Philosophy and self-examination
- Cultural commentary
- Enshitification and technology critique

## About & Overview

- [About](https://auxiliarymemory.com/about): About James Wallace Harris, retired programmer writing essays & SF
- [Auxiliary Memory – Things I want to remember](https://auxiliarymemory.com): Homepage featuring recent essays on loneliness, aging, and philosophy

## Retirement, Aging & Identity

- [How to Flourish and Avoid Languishing in Retirement and Old Age?](https://auxiliarymemory.com/2021/05/05/how-to-flourish-and-avoid-languishing-in-retirement-and-old-age): Exploring languishing vs flourishing in retirement per NYT essays
- [How Do You Label Your Existence?](https://auxiliarymemory.com/2022/05/03/how-do-you-label-your-existence): Retirement identity crisis after leaving programmer career behind
- [Asking Who, What, When, Where, Why and How About Ourselves](https://auxiliarymemory.com/2015/02/05/asking-who-what-when-where-why-and-how-about-ourselves): Retirement reflection on self-examination and life purpose questions
- [2026](https://auxiliarymemory.com/2026): Harris reflects on loneliness, aging, and existential questions re JWST
- [The Limits of Memory](https://auxiliarymemory.com/2025/03/03/the-limits-of-memory): Harris on memory limitations, aphantasia, and learning styles

## Science Fiction & Literature

- [The Defining Science Fiction Books of the 1950s](https://auxiliarymemory.com/2013/04/04/the-defining-science-fiction-books-of-1950s): Guide to essential 1950s SF novels from Golden Age era
- [How Much Can We Learn About the World Traveling by Books?](https://auxiliarymemory.com/2015/02/22/how-much-can-we-learn-about-the-world-traveling-by-books): Ann Morgan's world reading project and cultural exploration via books
- [Rereading: The Soul of a New Machine by Tracy Kidder](https://auxiliarymemory.com/2017/01/06/rereading-the-soul-of-a-new-machine-by-tracy-kidder): Review of Kidder's Pulitzer-winning book on Data General Eclipse MV/8000
- [william-shakespeare](https://auxiliarymemory.com/autobiography-of-reading/william-shakespeare): Reading autobiography entry on William Shakespeare

## Technology & Culture Critique

- [Can We Fight Back Against Enshitification?](https://auxiliarymemory.com/2026/02/09/can-we-fight-back-against-enshitification): Doctorow's enshitification concept and corporate extraction economy
- [I'm Too Dumb to Use Artificial Intelligence](https://auxiliarymemory.com/2024/01/20/im-too-dumb-to-use-artificial-intelligence): Failed attempt to use PrivateGPT for Philip K. Dick research
- [August 2024](https://auxiliarymemory.com/2024/08): Commentary on neoliberalism, Chris Murphy, and American capitalism crisis

## Dreams & Psychology

- [Do You Dream About Dinosaur Attacks?](https://auxiliarymemory.com/2014/06/29/do-you-dream-about-dinosaur-attacks): Analysis of recurring dinosaur attack dreams since childhood
- [Can't Find My Way Home Dreams](https://auxiliarymemory.com/2023/11/02/cant-find-my-way-home-dreams): Recurring dreams about getting lost and not finding home

- [2024](https://auxiliarymemory.com/2024): 2024 essays on family photos, genealogy, and Mac Mini M4 purchase

- [Do You Remember the Childhood of Famous Americans Series?](https://auxiliarymemory.com/2023/06/12/do-you-remember-the-childhood-of-famous-americans-series-of-biographies-written-for-children): Nostalgia for Bobbs-Merrill biography series from elementary school
- [What Method of Cursive Handwriting Was I Taught in 1959-1960?](https://auxiliarymemory.com/2024/03/25/what-method-of-cursive-handwriting-was-i-taught-in-1959-1960): Investigating Palmer Method vs other cursive techniques from childhood
- [Songs Rated 10](https://auxiliarymemory.com/2010/01/08/songs-rated-10): Personal essay on listening to favorite songs playlist at Lala.com
